agent.first_message: Hi {{recipient_name}}, this is the Northbridge Lettings automated assistant. I'm calling you as the {{recipient_role}} about an urgent issue at {{property}}. Have you got a minute?

dynamic_variable_placeholders.issue: The tenant's front door only shuts if it is slammed. A visiting engineer warned the tenant that the door glass will shatter if this continues.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.why_urgent: This is the main exit. Slamming risks the glass shattering and injuring someone, and the door may not secure the property.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.risk_if_delayed: Injury from broken glass, and an insecure property overnight.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.facts_uncertain: No contractor has inspected the door yet. We have not confirmed whether the glass is already cracked.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.options: Option 1: we send an emergency door and glazing contractor today to make it safe, estimated 150 to 300 pounds. Option 2: you use your own contractor, who must attend within 24 hours. Option 3: we apply temporary safety film or boarding today and book the full repair later.
dynamic_variable_placeholders.recommendation_reason: It removes the injury risk today and the cost is within a typical emergency call-out.

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call once the decision is confirmed, or a callback is agreed, or the person cannot talk.

chosen_option.description: The option number the person confirmed: "1", "2", "3" or "4". Return "none" if they did not clearly confirm a single option, declined all options, or asked for a callback.

decision_summary.description: One sentence describing exactly what the person decided, including any conditions, or why no decision was made.

spend_limit_gbp.description: Any maximum spend in GBP the person explicitly stated. Leave empty if none was stated.

callback_requested.description: True if the person asked for a human to call them back or could not decide on this call.
